card.line: Mamre was a place near Hebron in Canaan, close to the cave of Machpelah, where Abraham's family buried their dead and Jacob's family later returned.

moments.title: Abraham buys a burial field
moments.text: Abraham paid Ephron four hundred shekels of silver for the field and cave at Machpelah near Mamre. Then he buried his wife Sarah there.

moments.title: Isaac and Ishmael bury Abraham
moments.text: When Abraham died, his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah near Mamre. He was laid there with his wife Sarah.

moments.title: Jacob returns to Isaac
moments.text: Jacob came back to his father Isaac at Mamre, near Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac had stayed.

moments.title: Jacob asks to be buried
moments.text: Before he died, Jacob told his sons to bury him in the cave at Machpelah near Mamre. He said Abraham, Sarah, Isaac, Rebekah, and Leah were buried there.

moments.title: Jacob is buried at Machpelah
moments.text: Jacob's sons carried him to Canaan and buried him in the cave at Machpelah near Mamre, as he had told them.
